title: James Dyson's Coach House and the 5,127th Prototype
conflicts: Duration and date of the 5,127 prototypes differ: Dyson's 2011 column says 15 years (to DC01 in 1993), Wired 2012 five years to a 1983 design, HardwareZone 2016 five years with the 5,127th in 1984, Gale four years, Tes 1997 'five thousand prototypes and 15 penniless years'. The count is attributed to Dyson throughout, and the story says 1983 or 1984 depending on the account. Gale says three children by 1979; Dyson says his third was born by the 15th prototype (story follows Dyson). Sawmill vs factory cyclone (story follows Tes).
notes: 5,127 attributed as Dyson's own count, as instructed. The ousting from the Ballbarrow company and the single backer rest only on Gale Newsmakers (Encyclopedia.com). Dyson's own sites and Fast Company 2007 block automated requests. Funding marked bootstrapped despite one private backer and bank borrowing.
